question: A 29-year-old woman with persistent moderate asthma well controlled with fluticasone / salmeterol every 12 hours and terbutaline on demand discovers that she is 5 weeks pregnant. Which attitude is the most correct?

options.opa: Substitute fluticasone / salmeterol for budesonide / formoterol.
options.opb: Suspend fluticasone / salmeterol and keep only salbutamol on demand.
options.opc: Suspend fluticasone / salmeterol and try maintenance only with montelukast.
options.opd: Remove fluticasone / salmeterol and try maintenance only with budesonide at medium doses.
